items.summary:
## What

`prework-discovery-helper.sh --files` must not print an empty "Recent commits on target files" section when its value was mis-formatted. Warn on stderr for any `--files` entry that cannot be a path (it contains whitespace) or matches no file known to git, and keep the exit code and stdout contract unchanged.
